record.paper_title: Recent progress and open problems in the Bergman space
record.context_brief: Bounded quotient after adding one zero
record.original_question: Let A be a Bergman zero sequence in D, let phi_A be its zero divisor, and let phi_{A union {0}} be the zero divisor obtained after adding a zero at the origin. Is the quotient phi_{A union {0}}/phi_A always a bounded analytic function on D?

evidence.quote: PROBLEM 6 Is the function phi_A union {0}/phi_A always bounded

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{D}=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<1\}$ denote the open unit disk, and let $dA$ be normalized area measure on $\mathbb{D}$. For $0<p<\infty$, the Bergman space $A^p$ consists of all analytic functions $f:\mathbb{D}\to\mathbb{C}$ with $\|f\|_p^p=\int_{\mathbb{D}}|f|^p\,dA<\infty$. A sequence $A=\{a_n\}\subset\mathbb{D}$ is called an $A^p$-zero sequence if there exists $f\in A^p\setminus\{0\}$ whose zero set (with multiplicities) is exactly $A$. For an $A^p$-zero sequence $A$, the (canonical / extremal) zero divisor $\varphi_A\in A^p$ is the unique solution of the extremal problem
$$\sup\{\operatorname{Re} f(0):\ f\in A^p,\ \|f\|_p\le 1,\ f\text{ vanishes on }A\}.$$
Given an $A^p$-zero sequence $A$ that does not contain the origin, let $A\cup\{0\}$ denote the sequence obtained by adjoining a simple zero at the origin, and let $\varphi_{A\cup\{0\}}$ be the corresponding extremal zero divisor.

Prove or disprove: the quotient
$$\frac{\varphi_{A\cup\{0\}}(z)}{\varphi_A(z)}$$
is a bounded analytic function on $\mathbb{D}$, for every $A^p$-zero sequence $A$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem on whether the ratio of extremal Bergman-space zero divisors after adjoining a zero at the origin is bounded was posed in Hedenmalm's survey on the Bergman space and has been resolved affirmatively in the literature on contractive zero-divisors in Bergman spaces.

status_evidence.snippet: Problem 6: Is the function φ_{A∪{0}}/φ_A always bounded? — listed among problems with reported affirmative resolution.

status_evidence.title: Contractive Zero-Divisors in Bergman Spaces (Duren, Khavinson, Shapiro, Sundberg)
status_evidence.snippet: Establishes contractive divisor properties for canonical zero-divisors in A^p, including ratio estimates when adding zeros.
status_evidence.claim: The contractive divisor framework provides the boundedness of the ratio when one zero is added.
